foundry_refs.desc: POET returns to the decaying chapel shore and begins to rebuild a new, futuristic, modern, clean, and white temple, which constructs itself in unison with POET's actions.
The storm ceases, revealing only scattered remnants of the chapel washed ashore.
Literal visual match: Saffron-robed Buddhist monks on ancient stone temple steps in prismatic sunlight.
foundry_refs.line: With laps around infinity pools of edgeless dreams... that we too can walk on water.

foundry_refs.desc: Literal visual match: POET wading waist-deep through thousands of yellow chrysanthemums inside stone apothecary.
foundry_refs.line: In the awakening of dawn, in fresh muted colors: we can rebuild this temple. It's a new day — a catharsis for me to say.

foundry_refs.desc: Archival photos of past friends and events are reenacted within the new, futuristic temple setting.
Front-porch light switches on as group approaches.
Literal visual match: Two young Black brothers resting foreheads together surrounded by bioluminescent butterflies.
foundry_refs.line: Before our winds part ways — to a next lifetime. This is brotherhood.
